title.zh: 环形系统发育树与热图

source_publication_note: The supplied screenshot collection did not identify a verified paper/DOI for each image.

provenance.zh: 模拟树拓扑 分支长度及叶节点注释；仅复现图式，不能用于系统发育推断
provenance.en: Synthetic topology, branch lengths and heatmap annotations. No original phylogenetic relationships are available.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 原始带枝长的系统发育树、根、叶节点 ID 与属/门分类。
每个叶节点的 BBAA 检出分子/分母及对应比例，bsh 存在/缺失信息。
BBAA、bsh 的检测方法与阈值，属区块边界和颜色刻度范围。
en: Original phylogeny with branch lengths, rooting, tip IDs and genus/phylum classifications.
Numerator/denominator and resulting BBAA detection fraction per tip, plus bsh presence/absence.
BBAA/bsh assay methods and thresholds, genus-sector boundaries and color-scale limits.

preprocessing.zh: 将真实树转为边表并合并 tip 注释。此圆形布局把终端节点对齐到固定半径，不能从图上读出真实末端枝长；genus_labels 需按新树重新设置。
preprocessing.en: Convert the tree to edges and join annotations. This circular layout aligns terminal nodes to a fixed radius, so displayed terminal lengths are not original branch lengths. Update genus_labels for a replacement tree.
